title: A Knight of the Cumberland
author: Fox, John, Jr.
description: "A Knight of the Cumberland" by John Fox, Jr.
longDescription: is a novel written during the early 20th century that immerses readers in the rugged beauty and culture of the Cumberland Mountains. The narrative focuses on the adventures of the main characters as they venture into the wilds of these Appalachian hills, exploring themes of innocence, social dynamics, and the clash between different cultures.

authorInfo.bio: Fox, John, Jr. (1862–1919) is the author of A Knight of the Cumberland. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
